name: Bounded Shared-Brand Packet Composition / Interaction Audit
bounded_question: Can exact C0 Threshold K, MAT F1 Subtractive Channel, STA F2 Ring + Edge Witness, MOT F1A within-context succession and MOT CS2 context replacement coexist on bounded synthetic APP-like and WEB-like carriers without identity-carrier competition, misleading semantics, excessive visual authority, motion/state collision, or accessibility/reflow failure?

exact_identity_asset.law: Embed exact C0 geometry only; currentColor; no redraw, simplification or wordmark coupling.

composition_variants.role: diagnostic ablation with reserved identity slot
diagnostic ablation; ARIA semantics retained, authored STA carrier removed
diagnostic ablation; final semantic states update immediately

fixture_gap_law: system-ui / Segoe UI fallback only; typography is an unscored fixture and does not fill TYP-01
neutral grayscale only; no CLR-01 or Mineral Theater hue values
no product-specific vocabulary or shipping UI architecture
no iconography beyond exact C0 primary symbol

interaction_partition.STA: Three neutral native buttons; B is selected by aria-pressed. Keyboard focus is tested independently with real Tab traversal.
interaction_partition.F1A: Three already-present peer units only. Replay demonstrates within-context succession and never changes context ownership.
interaction_partition.CS2: One fixed-geometry context field exchanges between already-ready Context A and Context B only. It never staggers child elements.
interaction_partition.mutual_exclusion: F1A and CS2 may not run concurrently, chain automatically, or explain the same state change. Starting either test cancels and settles the other first.

mechanical_gates: all packet-source hashes and exact C0 canonical LF hash match
FULL plus all four ablations render in APP and WEB without source-packet retune
no horizontal document overflow at 1200 or 320
real Tab focus reaches enabled FULL state controls and yields >=2px visible focus ring; selected control retains STA witness
forced-colors preserves C0/content/focus/selection comprehension; decorative MAT geometry may flatten but may not obscure content
full-motion F1A uses exact research fixture and reaches exact final displacement per context
full-motion CS2 uses synchronized opacity exchange only, with exact research fixture and fixed host geometry
reduced-motion F1A and CS2 update immediately with zero authored animation/transition duration
F1A and CS2 have no overlapping active animations
all visible normal text meets >=4.5:1 contrast and authored essential non-text boundaries meet >=3:1 where applicable
subjective_integration_falsification: C0 no longer reads as the single primary identity mark because MAT geometry behaves like a second mark or dominant device
MAT F1 channels primarily read as navigation, direction, progress, semantic state or framing stronger than content
STA F2 witness visually merges with MAT channels or reads as progress/navigation/validation rather than restrained selection
F1A peer succession reads as loading, priority, process, causality or context replacement
CS2 reads as entrance/loading/overlay motion, produces fatiguing ghosting at the frozen low-density fixture, or overlaps F1A semantics
APP and WEB cease to read as the same underlying packet system
FULL is materially less clear or more fatiguing than a diagnostic ablation in a way attributable to a named packet collision
judgment depends on the unresolved fixture typography/color rather than packet interaction

result_law.pass: PASS_COMPATIBLE_COMPOSITION ? compatibility evidence only; source packets remain provisional and Phase-B remains open unless separately closed.
result_law.targeted_conflict: TARGETED_REFINEMENT_REQUIRED ? name exact packet interaction; preserve predecessors unchanged; open only a bounded successor/refinement gate.
result_law.insufficient: INSUFFICIENT_FIXTURE_EVIDENCE ? close CMP-01 without filling typography/color/product semantics ad hoc.
result_law.fail: FAIL_COMPOSITION_COLLISION ? frozen full composition cannot retain the included packet set without prohibited collision.

authority_limits: No final palette/material/type system, production token, component skin, app/site UI implementation or deployment.
No CLR-01 reentry, Mineral Theater recolor, TYP-01 rerun, O3/wordmark redesign, SYM-03, MAT F5, MOT cadence change, STA refinement or hero reopening.
No final identity or Phase-C convergence.
